name: FIM
title: Focusing Influence Mechanism for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yisak Park · Sunwoo Lee · Seungyul Han
summary: Focus on under-explored state dimensions and sustain collective influence to improve coordinated exploration under sparse rewards.

name: BGP
title: Escaping Path Mirages in Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
authors: Junhyeon Bae · Jaebak Hwang · Gwanwoo Choi · Minung Kim · Seungyul Han
summary: Research on offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning and the challenge of reaching long-horizon goals.

name: MARBO
title: MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
authors: Yechan Hwang · Sangjun Bae · Jeongmo Kim · Sangwoo Bang · Seungyul Han
summary: Ground strategic actions and in-game speech in reliable beliefs about hidden roles and team relationships.
detail: MARBO uses relational beliefs to guide preference optimization in social deduction games. Feedback depends on both the reliability of those beliefs and the strategic outcomes of the resulting behavior.

name: IBAL
title: Interaction-Breaking Adversarial Learning Framework for Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Sunwoo Lee · Mingu Kang · Yonghyeon Jo · Seungyul Han
summary: Train teams to maintain cooperation when adversarial perturbations disrupt interactions between agents.
detail: IBAL constructs observation and action perturbations that interfere with coordination. Adversarial training then teaches policies to remain effective under these interaction-focused disruptions, including evaluations with missing agents.

name: LMAC
title: LLM-Guided Communication for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Sangjun Bae · Yisak Park · Sanghyeon Lee · Seungyul Han
summary: Use an LLM to design communication protocols that help partially observable agents reconstruct the shared state.
detail: LMAC refines its communication protocol using a state-awareness criterion. The goal is to improve state reconstruction across agents while reducing differences in what each agent knows.

name: S2Q
title: Retaining Suboptimal Actions to Follow Shifting Optima in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yonghyeon Jo · Sunwoo Lee · Seungyul Han
summary: Keep alternative high-value actions available as the best joint strategy changes during training.
detail: Successive Sub-value Q-learning learns multiple sub-value functions rather than relying on a single optimal action. A softmax behavior policy uses these alternatives to sustain exploration and adapt to changing value estimates.

name: SSE
title: Strict Subgoal Execution: Reliable Long-Horizon Planning in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jaebak Hwang · Sanghyeon Lee · Jeongmo Kim · Seungyul Han
summary: Make long-horizon plans more reliable by separating feasible subgoals from unreachable ones.
detail: SSE combines graph-based hierarchical planning with Frontier Experience Replay. Failure and partial-success transitions help identify unreliable subgoals, while a separate exploration policy and path refinement improve coverage and planning.

name: WALL
title: Wolfpack Adversarial Attack for Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Sunwoo Lee · Jaebak Hwang · Yonghyeon Jo · Seungyul Han
summary: Study coordinated attacks on cooperating agents and learn team policies that can withstand them.
detail: The Wolfpack attack targets an initial agent and the teammates that assist it. Wolfpack-Adversarial Learning for MARL (WALL) trains policies against this coordinated disruption to improve robustness across the team.

name: FoX
title: FoX: Formation-aware exploration in multi-agent reinforcement learning
authors: Yonghyeon Jo · Sunwoo Lee · Junghyuk Yeom · Seungyul Han
summary: Guide exploration through diverse team formations in partially observable cooperative tasks.
detail: FoX organizes exploration around formations to reduce redundant search. Agents learn to recognize their formation from local observations and explore meaningful alternatives, with evaluations in sparse SMAC and Google Research Football tasks.
